code_points.observation: Copy and canonical paths pass skill.path to copyDirectory.
Explicit exclusions are metadata.json and the .git, __pycache__, __pypackages__ directories.
Remaining directory entries recurse or copy via cp; source mode bits retained.

installer_source_review.analysis_type: Static source review only; upstream test source read but not executed.
installer_source_review.conditional_inference: If this directory-copy path installs a selected skill, a regular sibling ZIP is not among these exclusions and qualifies for copying.
installer_source_review.limitation: Copy semantics do not establish a vulnerability, automatic execution, a zero-click exploit or endpoint compromise.

anonymous_candidates.observed_pattern: A purported official MCP integration has no server implementation in its inspected source tree, but directs readers toward a password-protected installer and disabling antivirus before administrator execution.
anonymous_candidates.assessment: Unsupported provenance and hazardous installation guidance observed. Malware behavior, attribution and novelty unconfirmed.

anonymous_candidates.observed_pattern: A README-only repository advertises open source, a license, verified hashes and clean scan badges without the corresponding source, license file, digest or independent scan report in its inspected tree.
anonymous_candidates.assessment: Security/source claims are unsupported by the inspected material. Malware behavior, attribution and novelty unconfirmed.

limits: No denominator can be combined into a campaign population without deduplication and compatible selection rules.
Three unavailable API resources are not three confirmed removed malicious repositories.
Absence from two pinned files does not establish prior nondisclosure or malware.

anonymous_corpus_finding.public_reproducibility_limit: The source identity is withheld. Public readers cannot reproduce these counts from the baseline lists alone.
anonymous_corpus_finding.artifact_scope: One committed JSON input dataset in a directory labelled validated; not the collector's whole corpus or an actual built index.
static_dataflow: Existing populated collection can return before files are imported.
Other JSONL inputs are processed before JSON inputs.
Deduplication keeps the first record for each repository URL.
A fresh build can join an eligible README's first 300 characters with name, description and language for an embedding document.
Retrieval returns metadata and distances, rather than the indexed README document.
Context formatting emits repository URLs and descriptions, rather than README text or ZIP URLs.
A conditional static call path uses the metadata context to construct a generation prompt.
anonymous_corpus_finding.interpretation: Known-list repository references and ZIP-bearing README snippets persist in a downstream input dataset. A static conditional ingestion/ranking path exists; actual indexing, recommendation, payload retrieval and compromise were not observed.

source_observation_phase.semantics: Original current_bytes_hash_verified and binary_analyzed values describe the source-phase observation time, not every later action in the completed investigation.

later_static_analysis_reference.note: Later pinned K2 bytes match the pinned Git blob and historical Island SHA-256. Readable DLL/Lua findings and executable access limits are in the separate artifact. One other archive comparison remains anonymous.
